**Shi Yigong** ([Chinese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_language "Chinese language"): 施一公; born 5 May 1967) is a Chinese [biophysicist](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biophysics "Biophysics") who serves as founding and the current president of [Westlake University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Westlake_University "Westlake University") since April 2018.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-:0-1) He previously served as vice president of [Tsinghua University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsinghua_University "Tsinghua University") from 2015 to 2018 and dean of Tsinghua University School of Life Sciences from 2009 to 2016.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-:1-2)

Shi Yigong received a [Bachelor of Science](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bachelor_of_Science "Bachelor of Science") with majors in [biology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biology "Biology") and [mathematics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mathematics "Mathematics") from Tsinghua University in 1989 and a [Doctor of Philosophy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doctor_of_Philosophy "Doctor of Philosophy") in [molecular biophysics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Molecular_biophysics "Molecular biophysics") from [Johns Hopkins University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johns_Hopkins_University "Johns Hopkins University") in 1995.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-:1-2)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-3)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-4) He studied at [Iowa State University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iowa_State_University "Iowa State University") for three months in 1990, before transferring to Johns Hopkins University.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-5)

During his graduate studies, he determined the [crystal structure](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crystal_structure "Crystal structure") of several critical apoptotic proteins, including [apaf-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apaf-1 "Apaf-1"), DIAP1, and the BIR3 domain of [XIAP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/XIAP "XIAP").

Shi Yigong was the Warner-Lambert/Parke-Davis Professor in the department of [Molecular Biology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Molecular_Biology "Molecular Biology") at [Princeton University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Princeton_University "Princeton University"). In June 2008, he was selected as a [Howard Hughes Medical Institute](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Howard_Hughes_Medical_Institute "Howard Hughes Medical Institute") investigator.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-6) However, he rejected the award upon resigning his position at Princeton University in order to pursue his career at [Tsinghua University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsinghua_University "Tsinghua University"), becoming the dean of the School of Life Sciences there.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-7) In 2003, he was appointed a Chair Professor of Tsinghua's Department of Biological Sciences and Biotechnology. In late 2007, He was appointed Vice Director of Tsinghua's Institute of Biomedicine and Vice Dean of Tsinghua's Department of Biological Sciences and Biotechnology before returning to China. He was appointed Dean of Tsinghua's School of Life Sciences (replacing the Department of Biological Sciences and Biotechnology) in 2009. In 2018, he became the founding and the first president of [Westlake University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Westlake_University "Westlake University"), a newly established private university in [Hangzhou](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hangzhou "Hangzhou").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-:0-1)

Shi [renounced his U.S. citizenship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Renunciation_of_United_States_citizenship "Renunciation of United States citizenship") in 2011 in order to reclaim his Chinese citizenship.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-Q32011-9)

Shi's grandfather was academic and politician [Shi Ping](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Ping "Shi Ping").[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-10) According to Shi, his father, Shi Huailin (施怀琳), was named after his mother Yang Lin (杨琳), who died 18 days after his birth, with 怀琳 literally meaning "remembering Lin".[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-Sina-11)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-Paper-12) As a result of his grandfather's work commitments, his father was estranged from his grandfather as a child, and friends and family raised his father.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-Sina-11)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-Paper-12) Shi's father and grandfather eventually reunited later in life.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-Sina-11)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-Paper-12)

His father died on 21 September 1987, at the age of 52.

His grandfather died on 29 June 2024, at the age of 112 years, 241 days.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-Sina-11)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi_Yigong#cite_note-Paper-12)
